purpose: Execution status per MGD obligation for the Mining M1 integration. The canonical obligation TRACE is owned by carrier #7795 and is not reachable from main; this file is the program-owned execution record that cites it.

authority.rationale: Planned test names resolve 0/40 on main and 2/40 at #7950, so a name audit reports 38 false gaps. Rows are keyed by obligation id.
authority.task_level_hazard: The carrier trace carries task 'T04' for all eight T04 rows and NO a/b split -- the split is R-MIN-05's. An earlier version of this file credited coverage with a task-level test, which credited all eight T04 rows to T04a's merge. The verdicts happened to be right; the rule was not, and it would credit a T04b row the same way. Each COVERED row now names the DELIVERED test id that pins it, and the generator asserts each named test exists in the suite.
authority.renamed_in_delivery: 4 of the 5 covered obligations are pinned by tests RENAMED from their planned names. That is the whole reason a name audit cannot measure this program.
authority.not_run_is_measured_by_subject_never_by_: ADDED 2026-09-27. `coverage_is_obligation_level_never_task_level` was stated for the CREDITING direction only; the denying direction was left open, and 30 rows were statused NOT_RUN from the note 'Owning task <T> has not landed on main' -- a task-level verdict on an obligation-level question. An obligation's OWNING TASK and the task delivering its SUBJECT are different facts: the carrier trace's `task` field is the planned delivery slot for the TEST, never a statement about which code the obligation governs. Six rows moved on measurement (MGD-15/16/17/20/21/22) and two kept their status with corrected reasons (MGD-19/23). THE RULE: status each row clause by clause, by asking which of four places the clause's subject lives in -- (i) merged code, (ii) the shared assertion contract, absent until #7870, (iii) an unlanded task's code, (iv) an unlanded UI. NOT_RUN is lawful only when NO clause's subject is on main. Corollary that cost two wrong verdicts this wave: a delivered test whose docstring cites an obligation may still not PIN it -- check that it exercises the composed payload and not a helper (MGD-19), and that the clause it asserts is the obligation's operative one (MGD-15 clause 2).
authority.scope_of_the_2026_09_27_subject_reaudit: What was actually re-measured, so a later lane does not read this file as a completed 40-row subject audit. RE-MEASURED AND RE-STATUSED: MGD-08 (code defect fixed, COVERED_SUITE_GREEN), MGD-15, MGD-16, MGD-17, MGD-20, MGD-21, MGD-22. RE-MEASURED, STATUS UNCHANGED, REASON REWRITTEN: MGD-19, MGD-23. READ AND ADJUDICATED UNCHANGED on measured grounds: MGD-02/03/05/06/07 (subjects are the unlanded T06 mount/labels and the T08 real-source journeys, which also need G2 before any live figure) and MGD-13/14/25 (their SECOND clauses are already unviolatable in delivered code -- the composer holds NO ownership field at all (0 occurrences in module and schema), copies `measure` verbatim without interpreting it, and orders rows by stable source identity rather than time via `_order_rows_by_stable_source_identity` -- but their FIRST clauses need T02's unlanded basis vocabulary, so NOT_RUN stands). NOT INDIVIDUALLY RE-MEASURED: every remaining NOT_RUN row; their notes still read task-level and must not be treated as subject-measured. Method note: the seven T03 rows were commissioned to an independent read-only audit which hit its turn limit and returned NO verdict, so the adjudication was done in the main loop -- which the routing registry required anyway, since a status adjudication is ROUTE judgment and main-loop-only. Evidence: probe_mgd15.py, probe_t03_seven.py, probe_t03_confirm.py, and 14 named delivered tests re-run green.

status_vocabulary.SATISFIED_BY_ABSENCE_OF_CAPABILITY: No delivered field or construct can express a violation. Becomes falsifiable when that field is minted, and owes a pin in the same PR.

status_vocabulary.DEFERRED_LAWFUL: Binds at a phase not yet reached. No test owed on main.
status_vocabulary.NOT_RUN: Owning task has not landed on main.

CLOSED 2026-09-27. Clause 1 was already pinned by the two positive witnesses. Clause 2 is now pinned two-armed across BOTH delivered slices, and closing it required a BEHAVIOUR CHANGE, not only a test: R-MIN-34's "NOT a code defect" held on W-C only. On W-R a wholly empty economic path returned `ready` over a panel whose native_blocks, derived and context_block_count were all empty, because the rare-earth slice vocabulary mints `stream_threshold_unknown` on every payload and that code short-circuited `_summarize_status` to `ready` before the native-block channel was consulted. Scoped the threshold clause to the NAMED-ABSENCE receipt `has_named_absence = bool(bundle.omissions)` and tested `has_native_blocks` first, and gated the "contract explanation is retained" headline on a non-degraded status. `bool(bundle.financial_packets)` was tried first and refuted by Opus review, verified independently: a packet the module routes out of every channel still counted as submitted, so four junk-packet shapes kept W-R `ready` over an empty panel. Zero of the 11 casebook cases change status, all 7 mining suites green (174 passed). MGD-18 / R-MIN-15 / plan §6 is untouched and stays green because its subject is different: case `missing_stream_threshold` SUBMITS one packet and has it withheld, whereas clause 2's subject submits nothing. Amended at source by R-MIN-35; R-MIN-34's row carries the AMENDED BY marker. This discharges MGD-08 ONLY -- T04b still owes the MGD-10 `period` arm, which is genuinely deferred until T04b mints that field. RESIDUAL STATE, corrected the same day after measuring it: a bundle naming an unrelated omission plus a packet that contributes to no channel still reads `ready`. By the rulings in force this is SATISFIED, not open, because an absence IS named (R-MIN-34's bar). Do NOT dispatch it as a fix: gating readiness on a CONTRIBUTING packet degrades `missing_stream_threshold`, which submits one non-contributing packet and which plan §6 VERBATIM requires `ready`; and minting a receipt at the drop site violates R-MIN-31 §I, which reserves `definition_unqualified:*` for definition fields and assigns a missing measurement datum to the bundle's omission mapping. Closing it means amending one of those frozen positions - an adjudication, not a lane task.

CORRECTED 2026-09-27 from NOT_RUN. The operative verb is 'refuse dependent arithmetic', and NO dependent arithmetic can exist on main: `economics['derived']` is the literal `[]` on all 11 casebook cases (hardcoded in the payload dict, `mining_theme_research.py` ~:955). No delivered construct can express a violation, so this is absence of capability, not coverage. Becomes falsifiable the moment `derived` is first populated and OWES A PIN IN THAT PR. The mismatch taxonomy itself (wet/dry, product vs contained-metal, stock/flow) does not exist on main either. Its second clause, 'without deleting supported facts', IS delivered and MEASURED -- a refused comparison leaves the supported native block intact (measured: expectations 0, native_blocks 1 @ value 1250, limitations ['definition_unqualified:unit','omitted:expectations'], status 'ready') -- and that survival is now PINNED GREEN by `tests/test_mining_composition.py::test_mgd17_refused_comparison_does_not_delete_the_supported_facts`, delivered in this same wave. That test carries a positive CONTROL arm -- it composes the identical bundle WITHOUT the bad comparison and requires the two native-block lists to be identical -- because 'the block survived' would prove nothing if the pipeline kept blocks unconditionally. Status moved from SATISFIED_BY_ABSENCE_OF_CAPABILITY to PARTIAL_BY_CONSTRUCTION when that pin landed: one clause is now pinned, so 'no delivered construct can express a violation' no longer describes the row. Clause 1 stays absence of capability and still owes its pin in the PR that first populates `derived`.
Clause 1 has no field to mis-encode: no ownership field exists on any delivered row or identity. Becomes falsifiable -- and owes a pin in the same PR -- the moment that field is minted.

REASON CORRECTED 2026-09-27; status unchanged. Measured: the composer is a PASSTHROUGH for `measure` -- submitted 'financing proceeds' composes verbatim as 'financing proceeds', never interpreted or mapped. Non-interpretation is not enforcement: because the composer never reads the measure's meaning, it can neither substitute financing for operating earnings NOR enforce that they stay distinct. So this is not absence of capability and not coverage -- it genuinely needs T03 to mint the input kind vocabulary (financing / cash availability / owned inventory / operating earnings) and then pin non-substitution against it. A test asserting the passthrough would NOT pin this obligation.
